The Wave 2.6 'Charleston 5/48 multiplicity-adjusted findings' is WITHDRAWN. Root causes: cross-architecture pairing; bootstrap p used a proportion where a count was required (inflated ~5000x); Monte-Carlo resolution floor exceeded Bonferroni alpha.

The production four-generator benchmark is NOT single-target: Diffusion-TS used the _wl series, the others used the residual. Its row is scored against its own target.
